Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

must also implement exponential backoff reconnection logic when communication with the local prometheus node exporter fails starting with initial interval of one hundred milliseconds capped at ten seconds. inspect dockerfile dot daemon to ensure multi stage docker builds discard clang compilation dependencies and produce minimal scratch based deployment containers. the site reliability team requires automated alerts in datadog when ring buffer dropped event ratio exceeds zero point zero one percent over five minute intervals. in the kernel probe directory examine filter dot c to verify that sock filter bytecodes validate ipv4 and ipv6 header checksums before processing payload slices. all bpf tail calls must use static jump tables with a maximum depth limit of thirty-two calls to prevent kernel stack overflow errors. the memory management team requires that memory cgroup limits for the collector daemon be configured to five hundred twelve megabytes in systemd unit definitions. inspect scripts slash deploy slash telemetry dot service to verify that restart policy is set to on failure with restart security delay of five seconds. the network operations center confirmed that bpf map dumps must be exportable to json format using bpftool map dump id for offline incident analysis. moreover the collector daemon must log all unrecognized packet protocols to audit log files with rate limiting capped at ten messages per second. verify that clang optimization passes preserve volatile memory pointers when reading hardware timestamps from bpf ktime get ns helper calls. security compliance requires that all ebpf program bytecode binaries be cryptographically signed using kernel module signing keys before loading into memory. the automated fuzzing suite in tests slash confirm that net core bpf jit enable is set to one. the platform security auditor requires that bpf program load events be logged to auditd daemon with process identity and file path. moreover the infrastructure manager on wednesday at two pm to approve production deployment across edge gateway nodes.", "output": "Systems performance team, we need to audit the Linux kernel eBPF network telemetry daemon before merging into mainline. First check C header definitions in include/telemetry/bpf.h to verify that struct packet_flow_identifier declares 32-bit source IP address, 32-bit destination IP address, 16-bit source port, and 16-bit destination port. Ensure that eBPF map definitions in kernel/maps.c configure packet_counter_map as a BPF_MAP_TYPE_PERCPU_HASH with max_entries configured to 1,000,000 entries and pin_map flag set to BPF_OBJ_PIN_ANY. In the Rust userspace collector daemon inspect src/daemon/collector.rs and verify that ring buffer consumer initializes with buffer size of 16 megabytes to prevent dropped packet events under bursty workloads. The userspace daemon must accept command-line arguments --prom-export on port 9100, --bpf-map-size set to 1,000,000, and --kernel-tracepoint configured to netif_receive_skb. In the eBPF kernel probe program verify that tcp connection tracker inspects tcphdr flags to accurately count SYN, ACK, and FIN packets without triggering kernel verifier rejections for unbounded loop execution. The principal systems engineer confirmed that BPF verifier log level must be set to 1 during debugging sessions. The daemon must also track socket buffer allocations in sk_buff structures and emit histogram distributions for connection establishment latency. Under no circumstances should any developer disable kernel BPF verifier safety checks using debug kernel parameters. In addition, inspect build scripts in Makefile and Cargo.toml to verify that clang compiles BPF objects with -O2 and -target bpf flags. The userspace Rust daemon must handle Unix signals SIGINT and SIGTERM gracefully by closing ring buffer subscriptions and unpinning eBPF maps from /sys/fs/bpf/telemetry. Verify that synthetic traffic benchmarks generated by iperf3 reach 10 gigabits per second throughput with CPU utilization remaining under 5% across all worker cores. All metrics exported to Prometheus must adhere to OpenTelemetry semantic conventions using snake_case metric names including network_packets_total and tcp_connection_duration_seconds. Incident response coordinators must also confirm that kernel warning messages are monitored in /var/log/messages via systemd-journald telemetry pipes. The infrastructure security group requires that the binary collector executable run under non-root service accounts using Linux capabilities CAP_BPF, CAP_NET_ADMIN, and CAP_PERFMON. In addition, the integration test harness in tests/integration/ebpf_test.rs must execute in GitHub workflows using GitHub Actions runners with kernel version 5.15 or newer. Furthermore verify that helper functions in libbpf.c utilize bpf_trace_printk strictly for development builds and remove all kernel printk calls from release binaries. The Rust daemon must also implement exponential backoff reconnection logic when communication with the local Prometheus node exporter fails, starting with initial interval of 100 milliseconds capped at 10 seconds. Inspect Dockerfile.daemon to ensure multi-stage Docker builds discard clang compilation dependencies and produce minimal scratch-based deployment containers. The site reliability team requires automated alerts in Datadog when ring buffer dropped event ratio exceeds 0.01% over 5-minute intervals. In the kernel probe directory examine filter.c to verify that sock_filter bytecodes validate IPv4 and IPv6 header checksums before processing payload slices. All BPF tail calls must use static jump tables with a maximum depth limit of 32 calls to prevent kernel stack overflow errors. The memory management team requires that memory cgroup limits for the collector daemon be configured to 512 megabytes in systemd unit definitions. Inspect scripts/deploy/telemetry.service to verify that restart policy is set to on-failure with restart security delay of 5 seconds. The network operations center confirmed that BPF map dumps must be exportable to JSON format using bpftool map dump id for offline incident analysis. Moreover, the collector daemon must log all unrecognized packet protocols to audit log files with rate limiting capped at 10 messages per second. Verify that clang optimization passes preserve volatile memory pointers when reading hardware timestamps from bpf_ktime_get_ns helper calls. Security compliance requires that all eBPF program bytecode binaries be cryptographically signed using kernel module signing keys before loading into memory. The automated fuzzing suite in tests/fuzz/packet_fuzzer.c must run continuously for 48 hours without triggering kernel panics. In addition, check file reference sysctl.conf in the system configuration directory to confirm that net.core.bpf_jit_enable is set to 1. The platform security auditor requires that BPF program load events be logged to auditd daemon with process identity and file path. Moreover, the collector daemon must verify that kernel page table isolation is active before allocating shared BPF ring buffer memory maps. Finally, schedule an architectural review with the Linux platform infrastructure manager on Wednesday at 2:00 PM to approve production deployment across edge gateway nodes."}]
